question_text:
If
\[f(n + 1) = (-1)^{n + 1} n - 2f(n)\]for $n \ge 1,$ and $f(1) = f(1986),$ compute
\[f(1) + f(2) + f(3) + \dots + f(1985).\]

Return only the final boxed answer content as a concise mathematical expression.
